description.zh: 理想黑体的辐射光谱由温度决定：峰值波长 λmax = b/T，总功率 σT⁴；经典理论在短波发散（紫外灾难），普朗克的能量量子 hν 让光谱收敛。理想黑体模型，真实物体发射率小于 1。
description.en: The spectrum of an ideal blackbody is set by its temperature: peak wavelength λmax = b/T, total power σT⁴; classical theory diverges at short wavelengths (the ultraviolet catastrophe) and Planck’s energy quantum hν tames the spectrum. An ideal-blackbody model; real objects have emissivity below 1.

reason.zh: 黑体辐射里 hν 的能量份解决了紫外发散，光电效应里同样的 hν 解释了光电子的最大动能，二者互相印证量子化。
reason.en: The energy unit hν resolves the ultraviolet divergence in blackbody radiation, and the same hν explains the maximum photoelectron energy, so the two support each other.

label.en: Temperature sets the thermal scale kT

reason.zh: 黑体辐射把一份光量子能量与热能 kT 比较，kT 正是气体动理论里温度对应的微观能量尺度。
reason.en: Blackbody radiation compares one light quantum with the thermal energy kT, the same microscopic energy scale that temperature has in kinetic theory.

title.zh: 为什么经典物理需要量子？
title.en: Why did classical physics need the quantum?

ask.zh: 经典理论预言黑体在短波处辐射无限大——实际测到的光谱在短波处是发散还是收敛？
ask.en: Classical theory predicted infinite radiation at short wavelengths — does the measured spectrum diverge or converge there?

ask.zh: 普朗克假设能量一份一份是 hν——这个假设怎样让短波部分的辐射不再发散？
ask.en: Planck assumed energy comes in chunks of hν — how does that stop the short-wave radiation from diverging?

reveal.zh: 经典理论在短波发散（紫外灾难），与实测不符；普朗克的能量量子 hν 让高频模式难以激发，光谱收敛，量子就此登场。
reveal.en: Classical theory diverged at short wavelengths — the ultraviolet catastrophe — contradicting measurement; Planck's energy quanta hν make high-frequency modes hard to excite, so the spectrum converges, and the quantum was born.
